- Implement a primality test for n: return False for n < 2; check divisibility by 2 and 3; then iterate i from 5 to sqrt(n) with step 6, checking n % i == 0 or n % (i+1) == 0.
- Use the primality result to return x if prime, otherwise return y.
- Optimize edge cases: handle n == 2 or 3 as prime directly; quickly reject even numbers and multiples of 3.
